Title: Anil's Day

Cast

1. Anil - 35 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Pallavi - 55 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Vikram - 37 years, friend
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The village well - a stone well, a rope and a bucket

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Anil stands by the road. Pallavi stands near him.]

Anil: "Today feels like a good day."

[Anil starts his scooter and rides off.]

Pallavi: "And then?"

[Anil drives the car to the office.]

Anil: "Yes, all right."

[Anil rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Anil (gently): "That's easy."

[The thug's knife wounds Anil in the stomach; he doubles over.]

Anil: "Show me too!"

[Anil's nose is bleeding after the punch.]

Pallavi (surprised): "Anil, look at this."

[Anil counts the notes and puts them in his wallet.]

Pallavi: "I knew it!"

Scene 2: The village well - Day

Vikram: "So, here we are!"

[Anil splashes water on his face at the well.]

Anil: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Anil grinds wheat on the stone hand-mill.]

Anil: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
